(VI)--a son of सम्ज्ञ; learned and great; antara of, constituting २८ yugas when राजऋषिस् rule at the end [page३-339+ ३०] of which a period of ४० yugas set in;
1: वा. १००. ५६; ९९. ४३५, ४५७-60; Vi.

offered the kingdom of earth after the epoch of चाक्षुष Manu; the first Manu had nine sons; finding at first that he could not create beings he caused a sacrifice in honour of Mitra and वरुण out of which came इडा or इला.
2: वा. ८

(II)--the epoch of Vaivasvata Manu in the वाराह Kalpa; the seventh Manu; Atri and six others are sages who re-establish dharma and reach the final beatitude; here are seven देवगणस्, साध्यस्, विश्वस्, Rud- रास्, Maruts, Vasus, अश्विन्स् and आदित्यस्. इक्ष्वाकु and 9 others are the sons of Vaivasvata Manu; the reference is to the present manvantara by the term साम्प्रतम्;
1:
